text:
lina (PM): Quick check-in: milestone-20 slipped after the KV hotpath and a new enterprise request for tenant isolation. I propose a scoped MVP freeze: ship SSO + billing telemetry + a "compact" promptstore (single-tenant admin + export). Defer multi-tenant routing, per-tenant QoS, and dashboards to v1. Goal: stabilize latency SLOs and give Sales a clear GA promise.

omar (Eng): Agree we should carve. Question: do we keep per-customer API keys or per-tenant keys for MVP-compact? Per-customer avoids auth changes.

lina (PM): Per-customer API keys for MVP-compact. Per-tenant keying is v1.

tara (Infra): Multi-tenant routing touches KV sharding; 3-5 infra days + e2e. Tail latency risk is real. Recommend we deploy a conservative limiter for GA. Example config we can ship now:
```json
{"global_rps": 600, "per_key_rps": 250, "burst_ms": 1000, "fallback_model": "rwd-small"}
```
This keeps noisy keys from impacting cluster tails.

mei (Design): For the console, we can add a temporary "dataset selector" under Admin that makes single-tenant explicit. Low-effort wires ready by EOD; label it clearly so users know it's GA-mode.

alex (Sales): Two enterprise prospects want tenant isolation. Sales can accept GA with single-tenant if we provide a customer note with an expected v1 window and a commitment to target SLA. Need Legal to review the language.

omar (Eng): Billing telemetry needs a stable event envelope before we freeze. Finance will require consistent fields. Also propose disabling webhooks for GA (v1) to reduce surface area.

lina (PM): Agreed — acceptance criteria for MVP-compact (draft):
- SSO (Okta/Google) enabled for admin and API key issuance
- Billing telemetry emitted per request (stable envelope v1.0)
- Compact promptstore: single-tenant admin CRUD + export/import only
- Conservative rate limiter active by default
- Canary healthchecks + staged rollout policy
If any team has blocking concerns, flag now.

sheriff-bot: deploy-bot: canary pipeline queued: milestone-20/compact-ga (ci#12045) :rocket:

tara (Infra): Can deliver limiter + canary hooks within 48h if we reprioritize two infra cycles. Will also add a runtime flag for a "beta-tenant" trial.

omar (Eng): If infra ships limiter and a billing envelope spec by Wed EOD, Eng will freeze the trimmed surface and focus on hardening. Else we keep original scope and push the GA date.

alex (Sales): Please include an "expected v1 date" in the customer note. Sales will not sell GA without that clarity.

mei (Design): Ill attach the admin wires and a short UX note about the tenant selector copy; aim to reduce support friction.

lina (PM): Thanks. Ill draft the customer note and roadmap update if no blockers by EOD. Legal: please review once I post the PRD link. :thumbsup:
